response.justification: Bogdan's extensive experience as a fullstack developer, particularly with TypeScript, React, and Nest.js, aligns well with the role's requirements. His background in building scalable, pragmatic solutions—evidenced by roles at Optilyz and re:cinq—demonstrates his ability to handle fullstack responsibilities. While his recent work leans heavily towards AI-agent infrastructure and Dlang, his foundational skills and adaptability suggest strong potential for growth in the renewable energy/construction tech domain.
strengths: Deep fullstack expertise with TypeScript, React, and Node.js across multiple roles
Proven ability to work in high-performance environments (e.g., millions of HTTP requests at Dunnhumby)
Strong background in scalable architecture (Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD) and pragmatic problem-solving
concerns: Limited direct experience with PostgreSQL (uses MongoDB primarily)
Recent focus on AI-agent infrastructure may dilute immediate relevance to core fullstack duties
High seniority level (Staff/Principal roles) may indicate overqualification for an entry-level position
